title: Beyond Imitation: Auditing the Recoverability of Reasoning in Distilled Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.26216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A correct teacher solution becomes useful supervision when the receiving student can continue its reasoning. We measure this compatibility with prefix recovery: after revealing 25%, 50%, or 75% of a verified solution, we test whether the student completes it correctly. We connect recovery to the cosine conflict between cross-entropy and reverse-KL gradients over the full vocabulary. Across adjacent Qwen3 teacher-student pairs from 0.6B to 8B parameters, reverse-KL distillation delivers its most consistent mathematical and code improvements for the two students below 2B parameters. On a fixed cohort of 1,000 trajectories, average prefix recovery rises from 71.0% to 91.9% as student size increases from 0.6B to 4B, and the robust-fragile recovery gap contracts from 46.0 to 14.4 percentage points. translated_title: 超越模仿：审计蒸馏模型中推理的可恢复性
translated_abstract: 当接收知识的学生模型能够继续其推理时，教师的正确解答才能成为有用的监督信号。我们通过前缀恢复度来衡量这种兼容性：在展示经验证解答的25%、50%或75%之后，测试学生模型能否正确完成剩余部分。我们将恢复度与交叉熵和反向KL散度梯度在整个词表上的余弦冲突联系起来。在从0.6B到8B参数的相邻Qwen3师生模型对中，反向KL蒸馏对两个参数低于2B的学生模型带来了最一致的数学和代码能力提升。在一个固定的1000条轨迹队列上，随着学生模型规模从0.6B增长到4B，平均前缀恢复率从71.0%上升到91.9%，而鲁棒-脆弱恢复差距从46.0个百分点缩小到14.4个百分点。当教师模型固定为8B时，冲突分离度从0.993下降到0.233。一项独立的目标函数干预实验发现，反向KL蒸馏（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“前缀恢复度”这一新指标来审计蒸馏模型中推理的可继承性，并发现学生模型规模是关键——2B以下的小型学生从反向KL蒸馏中获益最大，且恢复能力与交叉熵和反向KL梯度间的余弦冲突密切相关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "prefix recovery" as a novel metric for auditing reasoning inheritability in distilled models, revealing that student scale is decisive—sub-2B students benefit most from reverse-KL distillation—and that recoverability is closely tied to the cosine conflict between cross-entropy and reverse-KL gradients.
